name: Twin-Bolt Deadeye
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, bigger than other imps, a round glass monocle over each eye, a white-hot bolt of fire held between the claws of each hand like darts

poses.stand: hovering very still on slow wings, both white-hot darts held up by its cheeks, aiming to the right
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers still, adjusting both glass monocles and squinting

attack.action: flicks one white-hot dart forward to the right, then the other right after it, then lowers both arms

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
